newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila 11-mth coconut oil exports down.
newsitem.headline: Manila 11-mth coconut oil exports down.

text.p: Philippine coconut oil exports in the first 11 months of the year reached 741,208 tonnes compared with 1,222,740 tonnes in the same period last year, trade group United Coconut Associations of the Phils Inc (UCAP) said.
Coconut products exports dropped 62 percent to 1,324,202 tonnes from January to November this year from the year-ago 2,146,148 tonnes, it said.
UCAP said coconut product exports include copra, coconut oil, dessicated coconut and oleochemicals.
For November alone, the country's coconut oil exports reached 85,025 tonnes from the year-ago 95,171 tonnes.
Manila vegetable oil dealers said the figures were within their expectations.
"The November coconut oil export figure was slightly higher compared to previous months due to carry over stocks from October," one trader said.
Ship delays in the delivery of coconut oil in October were carried-over in November, the trader added.
The trader said he expected coconut oil exports to reach 820,000 tonnes this year from the previous 1.334 million tonnes. -- Manila newsroom (632) 841-89-36, fax 817-62-67
